name: Royal Duty / Flush!!
source:
Yuuma attends a school for the elite and wealthy and does not have any relatives. He spends his days like a commoner as much as possible, while quite aware of the elite status of those around him. However, one day he was proposed to by a transfer student who was the princess of a small country! It was their custom to find a marriage partner as part of their coming of age ceremony and she had come to his school to do just that. His objections fell on deaf ears and when he looked to his childhood friend for help, she confessed that she had always loved him.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/02/01/february-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
游马就读于精英和富人学校，没有任何亲戚。他尽可能地像平民一样度过日子，同时也很清楚周围人的精英地位。然而有一天，他被一位小国公主的转校生求婚了！作为成年仪式的一部分，他们有寻找结婚对象的习俗，而她来到他的学校就是为了这样做。他的反对被置若罔闻，当他向儿时好友寻求帮助时，她承认她一直爱着他。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/02/01/february-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
